row: Residential route polygons for trash and recycling.

Each polygon within the two files represents a residential trash or recycling route. These routes are
for Monday - Friday residential service. There are a greater number of daily trash routes that cover
more compact areas in comparison to recycling routes. This is not a production file, but it can be
used as a general representation of residential route coverage.

This is not a production file and is only updated as needed. Reasons for updating may include but are
not limited to: the presence of newly developed areas, major route changes, etc.
